commands: colcon test --packages-select turtle_bringup patrol course_bringup --event-handlers console_direct+
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=best_effort record:=true bag_dir:=evidence/pr05/bag

tests.name: colcon build for turtle_bringup, patrol, and course_bringup
colcon test for selected workspace packages
live QoS incompatibility and compatible delivery

defect.reproducer: A reliable subscriber and ros2 topic echo received no messages from the visible /robot_a/sensor_pose best-effort publisher during a three-second timeout.
defect.root_cause: DDS reliability compatibility is requested-versus-offered: a RELIABLE reader cannot match a BEST_EFFORT writer.
defect.proof_after: With subscriber_reliability:=best_effort, the live echo received Pose messages; the same profile also received messages from the recorded MCAP using config/qos-overrides.yaml.
